_note: AHN is a subsidiary of Highmark Health; AHN issues its own bonds separately. Highmark Inc. holds an A rating (S&P). AHN ratings tracked separately at lower investment grade.

moodys.citation_text: AHN obligated group historically rated by S&P and Fitch only; Moody's coverage at Highmark parent level.

sp.citation_text: S&P rated AHN at A- entering 2020 consistent with $1B AHN bond issuance pricing in 2018 and S&P's coverage of Highmark/AHN obligated group. _warning: starting notch inferred from prnewswire 2018 bond release and 2018 ratings; not direct S&P 2020 doc.

fitch.citation_text: Fitch rated AHN A- stable at 2018 $1B bond closing and held into the window. _warning: 2020 reaffirmation not separately verified.

outcome_class_rationale: AHN ratings held flat at A- across the window. AHN took COVID hit ($136M FY2020 operating loss, $119M FY2021 operating loss, $181M FY2022 operating loss) but parent Highmark Health's $450M earnings and explicit financial support kept rating agencies from downgrading the subsidiary obligated group in 2021-2022. The deterioration that prompted rating actions was 2023+ (out of window).

operating_metrics_fy2020.citation_text: AHN delivered FY2020 operating loss of $136M on revenue of $3.6B per Highmark 2020 Annual Report. Operating margin ~-3.8%. Long-term debt $1B from 2018 bond issuance plus prior debt.

ma_events_2021_2022.counterparty: AHN Wexford Hospital (new build, joint with Emerus)
ma_events_2021_2022.rationale: AHN Wexford 160-bed, $313M new construction hospital opened fall 2021. Part of $1B AHN/Highmark expansion plan. Funded from prior debt issuance — net new leverage limited in 2021-2022 window.
